newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Network Entertainment lists at premium.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Network Entertainment lists at premium.

text.p: The shares of video and CD rom distribution company, Network Entertainment Group Ltd opened at A$2.15, a 7.5 percent premium to their issue price of A$2.00 when they listed on the Australian Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
At 11.05 a.m. (0005 GMT), Network Entertainment stock was 13 cents higher at A$2.13 on turnover of 149,318 shares.
Network Entertainment was owned by multimedia company Shomega Ltd which was acquired by publishing group Pacific Magazines and Publishing Ltd earlier this year.
The company issued six million shares to raise a total of A$12 million, representing 35 percent of the company's issued capital.
The remaining 65 percent of the company is owned by its senior management and associates.
